_comment: Hand-written tips for vanilla advancements (by id), used by Merl's advancement coach in the mod.

tips.minecraft:story/mine_stone: Craft a wooden pickaxe and mine any stone block.
tips.minecraft:story/upgrade_tools: Three cobblestone and two sticks make a stone pickaxe.
tips.minecraft:story/smelt_iron: Iron ore is common around Y 16 and in mountains. Smelt the raw iron in a furnace.
tips.minecraft:story/obtain_armor: Any piece of iron armor counts. Boots are the cheapest: four iron ingots.
tips.minecraft:story/lava_bucket: Lava pools are common deep underground and on the surface in deserts. Use an empty bucket on a source block.
tips.minecraft:story/iron_tools: Three iron ingots and two sticks make an iron pickaxe.
tips.minecraft:story/deflect_arrow: Hold a shield and block a skeleton's arrow by right-clicking.
tips.minecraft:story/form_obsidian: Pour water onto a lava source block. Lava pools in caves are a great spot.
tips.minecraft:story/mine_diamond: Diamonds are most common near the bottom of the world, around Y -58. Strip mining or caving both work.
tips.minecraft:story/enter_the_nether: Build a 4×5 obsidian frame (corners optional) and light it with flint and steel.
tips.minecraft:story/shiny_gear: Any piece of diamond armor counts. Boots need just four diamonds.
tips.minecraft:story/enchant_item: Craft an enchanting table with a book, two diamonds and four obsidian, then enchant anything.
tips.minecraft:story/cure_zombie_villager: Throw a splash potion of Weakness at a zombie villager, then give it a golden apple. Keep it out of the sun while it shakes.
tips.minecraft:story/follow_ender_eye: Throw eyes of ender: they fly toward the nearest stronghold. Dig down where they sink into the ground.
tips.minecraft:story/enter_the_end: Fill all 12 frames of the stronghold portal with eyes of ender and jump in. Bring blocks, a bow and a pumpkin for your head!
tips.minecraft:nether/return_to_sender: Hit a ghast's fireball back at it, with your hand, a sword or an arrow.
tips.minecraft:nether/find_bastion: Bastions are in every Nether biome except basalt deltas. They're big and made of blackstone.
tips.minecraft:nether/obtain_ancient_debris: Ancient debris is most common around Y 15 in the Nether. Beds or TNT blow open big tunnels fast (beds explode there!).
tips.minecraft:nether/fast_travel: Travel 7 km in the Overworld by moving through the Nether: build a long tunnel at Y 128+ or across the roof.
tips.minecraft:nether/find_fortress: Fortresses are long dark-red brick bridges. Head along the X or Z axis; they're spread out in strips.
tips.minecraft:nether/obtain_crying_obsidian: Piglins sometimes give crying obsidian in trades, and ruined portals have it too.
tips.minecraft:nether/distract_piglin: Throw a gold ingot to an angry piglin, or one that is about to attack you.
tips.minecraft:nether/ride_strider: Saddle a strider and hold a warped fungus on a stick. Saddles come from bastions, fishing and fortresses.
tips.minecraft:nether/uneasy_alliance: Push or lure a ghast through a nether portal into the Overworld, then kill it there. A fishing rod or boat helps.
tips.minecraft:nether/loot_bastion: Open any chest in a bastion remnant. Watch out for piglin brutes!
tips.minecraft:nether/use_lodestone: Use a compass on a lodestone.
tips.minecraft:nether/netherite_armor: You need 4 netherite ingots for a full set, upgraded from diamond armor at a smithing table.
tips.minecraft:nether/get_wither_skull: Wither skeletons live in fortresses. Looting III raises the skull chance from 2.5% to 5.5%.
tips.minecraft:nether/obtain_blaze_rod: Blazes spawn near blaze spawners in fortresses. Snowballs hurt them, and a fire resistance potion helps a lot.
tips.minecraft:nether/charge_respawn_anchor: Craft a respawn anchor (6 crying obsidian, 3 glowstone) and fill it up with 4 glowstone blocks.
tips.minecraft:nether/explore_nether: Visit all five Nether biomes: Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest and Basalt Deltas.
tips.minecraft:nether/summon_wither: Four soul sand or soul soil in a T and three wither skeleton skulls on top. Fight it underground or far from your base!
tips.minecraft:nether/brew_potion: Brew any potion: water bottle + nether wart in a brewing stand fuelled with blaze powder.
tips.minecraft:nether/create_beacon: Craft a beacon from a nether star, three obsidian and five glass, and place it on a pyramid.
tips.minecraft:nether/all_potions: Have every potion effect at once (instant ones like Healing don't count). Brew them all first, then drink them quickly, longest-lasting first.
tips.minecraft:nether/create_full_beacon: A full beacon pyramid has 4 layers: 164 iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite blocks.
tips.minecraft:nether/all_effects: Have every status effect at once. This is a famously hard challenge: plan it carefully!
tips.minecraft:end/kill_dragon: Destroy the end crystals first (some are caged: climb up or use arrows), then attack the dragon. Beds explode in the End, so speedrunners use them.
tips.minecraft:end/dragon_egg: Push the egg off the portal with a piston, or let it fall onto a torch. Clicking it teleports it.
tips.minecraft:end/enter_end_gateway: After the dragon, throw an ender pearl into the small gateway portal floating near the main island's edge.
tips.minecraft:end/respawn_dragon: Place 4 end crystals around the exit portal, one on each side.
tips.minecraft:end/dragon_breath: Hold an empty glass bottle into the dragon's purple breath cloud.
tips.minecraft:end/find_end_city: Take an end gateway to the outer islands and look for purple towers.
tips.minecraft:end/elytra: Elytra hang in item frames on end ships, next to some end cities.
tips.minecraft:end/levitate: Float 50 blocks up with a shulker's levitation. Stand on a pillar below one and let it hit you a few times.
tips.minecraft:adventure/trade: Trade with any villager or a wandering trader.
tips.minecraft:adventure/honey_block_slide: Jump at the side of a honey block and slide down it.
tips.minecraft:adventure/ol_betsy: Craft a crossbow and shoot it.
tips.minecraft:adventure/lightning_rod_with_v: Place a lightning rod near a villager during a thunderstorm and keep fire away. Tricky, but the rod makes it much more likely.
tips.minecraft:adventure/sleep_in_bed: Sleep in any bed to set your spawn point.
tips.minecraft:adventure/hero_of_the_village: Win a raid: drink an ominous bottle and walk into a village.
tips.minecraft:adventure/throw_trident: Throw a trident at anything. Drowned that hold one can drop it.
tips.minecraft:adventure/kill_all_mobs: Monster Hunter means killing every hostile mob kind. The Missing list shows what's left; the rare ones are often the evoker, the shulker and the elder guardian.
tips.minecraft:adventure/totem_of_undying: Hold a totem of undying in a hand while taking deadly damage. Evokers drop totems.
tips.minecraft:adventure/summon_iron_golem: Four iron blocks in a T and a carved pumpkin on top.
tips.minecraft:adventure/two_birds_one_arrow: Kill two phantoms with one piercing crossbow arrow.
tips.minecraft:adventure/whos_the_pillager_no: Kill a pillager with a crossbow.
tips.minecraft:adventure/arbalistic: Kill five different mob kinds with one crossbow shot. Piercing IV and a crowded mob farm help.
tips.minecraft:adventure/adventuring_time: Visit every Overworld biome. Ask me "which biomes haven't I visited?" and I'll find the closest missing one!
tips.minecraft:adventure/play_jukebox_in_mead: Play any music disc in a jukebox inside a Meadow biome.
tips.minecraft:adventure/walk_on_powder_snow_: Wear leather boots and walk on powder snow without sinking.
tips.minecraft:adventure/spyglass_at_parrot: Look at a parrot through a spyglass.
tips.minecraft:adventure/spyglass_at_ghast: Look at a ghast through a spyglass.
tips.minecraft:adventure/spyglass_at_dragon: Look at the Ender Dragon through a spyglass.
tips.minecraft:adventure/very_very_frightenin: Hit a villager with a trident enchanted with Channeling during a thunderstorm.
tips.minecraft:adventure/sniper_duel: Kill a skeleton with an arrow from 50 or more blocks away.
tips.minecraft:adventure/bullseye: Hit the bullseye of a target block from 30 or more blocks away.
tips.minecraft:adventure/fall_from_world_heig: Fall from the build limit (Y 320) down to the bottom of the world and survive. Water at the bottom!
tips.minecraft:adventure/avoid_vibration: Sneak near a sculk sensor or the warden without setting it off.
tips.minecraft:adventure/salvage_sherd: Brush suspicious sand or gravel to get a pottery sherd.
tips.minecraft:adventure/craft_decorated_pot_: Craft a decorated pot from four sherds.
tips.minecraft:adventure/trim_with_any_armor_: Use any armor trim template at a smithing table.
tips.minecraft:adventure/trim_with_all_exclus: Use the Spire, Snout, Rib, Ward, Silence, Vex, Tide and Wayfinder trims.
tips.minecraft:adventure/read_power_of_chisel: Put a comparator next to a chiseled bookshelf.
tips.minecraft:adventure/under_lock_and_key: Open a vault with a trial key.
tips.minecraft:adventure/revaulting: Open an ominous vault with an ominous trial key.
tips.minecraft:adventure/blowback: Kill a breeze with its own deflected wind charge.
tips.minecraft:adventure/who_needs_rockets: Launch yourself 8 blocks up with a wind charge.
tips.minecraft:adventure/crafters_crafting_cr: Watch a crafter craft a crafter.
tips.minecraft:adventure/lighten_up: Scrape a copper bulb with an axe to make it brighter.
tips.minecraft:adventure/overoverkill: Deal 50 hearts of damage with one mace smash. Fall from very high!
tips.minecraft:husbandry/breed_an_animal: Feed two animals of the same kind their favorite food.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/tame_an_animal: Tame a wolf with bones, a cat with raw fish, or a parrot with seeds.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/fishy_business: Catch any fish with a fishing rod.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/bred_all_animals: Breed every breedable animal. The Missing list shows which ones are left.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/balanced_diet: Eat every kind of food once, including the gross ones like rotten flesh, spider eyes, pufferfish and poisonous potatoes.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/complete_catalogue: Tame every cat variant. Different cats spawn in villages, and black cats in witch huts.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/tactical_fishing: Catch a fish with a bucket, no fishing rod.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/axolotl_in_a_bucket: Use a water bucket on an axolotl in a lush cave.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/kill_axolotl_target: Team up with an axolotl and let it win a fight.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/silk_touch_nest: Move a bee nest with three bees inside using a Silk Touch tool.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/safely_harvest_honey: Put a campfire under a beehive, then use a glass bottle on it.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/ride_a_boat_with_a_g: Get a goat into a boat with you. A lead helps.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/make_a_sign_glow: Use a glow ink sac on a sign.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/allay_deliver_item_t: Give an allay an item; it brings you matching items.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/allay_deliver_cake_t: Give an allay a cake and let it drop it at a note block.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/tadpole_in_a_bucket: Use a water bucket on a tadpole.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/leash_all_frog_varia: Leash a temperate, a warm and a cold frog at the same time.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/froglights: Have all three froglights in your inventory. Each frog kind eats small magma cubes for one color.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/wax_on: Use honeycomb on a copper block.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/wax_off: Scrape the wax off a copper block with an axe.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/obtain_netherite_hoe: Upgrade a diamond hoe with a netherite ingot. Serious dedication!
tips.minecraft:husbandry/plant_any_sniffer_se: Plant a torchflower seed or pitcher pod from a sniffer.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/obtain_sniffer_egg: Brush suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/feed_snifflet: Feed a baby sniffer torchflower seeds.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/repair_wolf_armor: Use armadillo scutes on damaged wolf armor.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/remove_wolf_armor: Use shears on a wolf's armor.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/whole_pack: Tame every wolf variant. Each one lives in a different biome.
tips.minecraft:husbandry/place_dried_ghast_in: Put a dried ghast block in water and wait for the ghastling.
